summary: The diff implements fixes for both REQ-1 and REQ-2. The useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout hook was refactored to use an overall timeout covering both the actor-wait and admin-check phases, to skip the admin check when identity is not yet initialized or not authenticated, and to expose a retry callback and error/timedOut states. The AdminDashboard was updated to consume these new states and render appropriate UI for loading, timeout, error, and unauthenticated cases. Both read-only files (useInternetIdentity.ts and useActor.ts) appear untouched. All existing admin UI tabs (collections, NFT items) are preserved.
